verse: You are a chosen race, a royal priesthood, a holy nation, an acquired people, so that you may proclaim the mighty acts of him who has called you out of darkness into his marvelous light. (1 Pet 2:9)
You are the salt of the earth; but if salt has lost its taste, how can it become salty again? It is no longer good for anything but is cast out and trampled under foot by people. (Matt 5:13)

You are the light of the world. A city built on a hill cannot be hidden. No one lights a lamp and puts it under the bushel, but on the lampstand, and it gives light to all who are in the house. In the same way, let your light shine before others, so that they may see your good works and glorify your Father who is in heaven. (Matt 5:14-16)
For we are his workmanship, created in Christ Jesus for good works, which God ordained beforehand, that we should walk in them. (Eph 2:10)

But you, Israel, my servant, Jacob, whom I have chosen, the seed of Abraham, my friend; you whom I took from the ends of the earth, and called from its remotest parts, and said to you, “You are my servant, I have chosen you and not cast you away” (Is 41:8-9)
For you are a holy people to the Lord your God; the Lord your God has chosen you to be his treasured possession, out of all the peoples on earth. (Deut 7:6)
You are all the children of God by faith in Christ Jesus. (Gal 3:26)
The Spirit himself bears witness with our spirit that we are children of God, and if children, then heirs - heirs of God and joint heirs with Christ. (Rom 8:16-17)
Even the very hairs of your head have all been numbered. Therefore, do not be afraid. You are worth more than many sparrows. (Luk 12:7)

As many of you as have been baptized into Christ have clothed yourselves with Christ. There is now neither Jew nor Greek, there is neither slave nor free, there is neither male nor female; For you are all one in Christ Jesus. And if you belong to Christ, then you are Abraham’s descendants and heirs according to the promise. (Gal 3:27-29)
I will be a father to you, and you shall be my sons and daughters, says the Lord Almighty. (2 Cor 6:18)
O Lord, you have searched me and known me. You know when I sit down and when I stand up; you understand my thoughts from far away. (Ps 139:1-2)
At one time you were not a people, but now you are the people of God; once you had not obtained mercy, but now you have obtained mercy. (1 Pet 2:10)
God is faithful; by whom you were called into the fellowship of his Son, Jesus Christ our Lord. (1 Cor 1:9)

I will make of you a new sharp threshing instrument having teeth; you shall thresh the mountains and crush them small, and you shall make the hills like chaff. You shall fan them and the wind shall carry them away, and the whirlwind shall scatter them. You shall then rejoice in the Lord; and shall glory in the Holy One of Israel. (Is 41:15-16)

You are my war club, my battle weapon: with you I break in pieces the nations, and with you I destroy kingdoms; with you I break in pieces the horse and its rider; with you I break in pieces the chariot and its rider. (Jer 51:20-21)

The spirit of the Lord God is upon me, because the Lord has anointed me to bring good news to the poor. He has sent me to bind up the brokenhearted, to proclaim freedom to the captives, and release to the prisoners. (Is 61:1)
Gird your loins and have your lamps lit; be like people waiting for their master to return from the wedding, so that as soon as he comes and knocks, they may open the door for him (Luk 12:35)
He has chosen us in Christ before the foundation of the world, that we should be holy and blameless before him in love. (Eph 1:4)

He destined us to be his adopted children through Jesus Christ, according to the good pleasure of his will, to the praise of the glory of his grace that he freely bestowed on us in his beloved son. (Eph 1:5-6)

Partake with me in suffering for the gospel, relying on the power of God, who saved us and called us with a holy calling, not according to our works but in accordance with his own purpose and grace. (2 Tim 1:8-9)

Jesus said to him, “Go home to your friends, and tell them what great things the Lord has done for you, and how he has shown mercy on you.” And he departed and began to proclaim in the Decapolis what great things Jesus had done for him; and everyone was amazed. (Mrk 5:19-20)
Therefore, go forth and teach all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father and of the Son and of the Holy Spirit. (Matt 28:19)
Preach the word; be persistent whether it is in season or out of season; correct, rebuke, and encourage, with the utmost patience and teaching. (2 Tim 4:1-2)
But as for you, truly, be vigilant, laboring in all things. Do the work of an Evangelist, fulfill your ministry. Be sober. (2 Tim 4:5)
Go through, go through the gates, prepare the way for the people; build up, build up the highway, remove the stones, lift up the standard of the people. (Is 62:10)

Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who by his abundant mercy has given us a new birth into a living hope through the resurrection of Jesus Christ from the dead to an inheritance that is incorruptible, undefiled, and that does not fade, reserved in heaven for you. (1 Pet 1:3-4)
Choose today whom you will serve… but as for me and my household, we will serve the Lord. (Josh 24:15)
Sing unto the Lord, bless his name; proclaim his salvation from day to day. Declare his glory among the nations, his wonderous works among all the peoples. (Ps 96:2-3)
Be all the more diligent to confirm your calling and election, for if you do this, you will never stumble and fall. (2 Pet 1:10)
What I tell you in darkness, speak in the light. And what you hear whispered in the ear, preach above the rooftops. (Matt 10:27)
Cry out! Cease not! Exalt your voice like a trumpet, and announce to my people their wicked acts, and to the house of Jacob their sins. (Is 58:1)
Sanctify Christ the Lord in your hearts, being always ready to give an answer to all who ask you the reason for that hope which is in you. (1 Pet 3:15)
Do not choose to be negligent, for the Lord has chosen you so that you would stand before him, and minister to him, and make offerings to him. (2 Chron 29:11)
He said to them: “Go forth to the whole world and preach the Gospel to every creature.” (Mrk 16:15)
I have set you among my people as a tester and a refiner so that you may know and try their ways. (Jer 6:27)
I have made you this day a fortified city, an iron pillar, and a bronze wall, against the whole land. (Jer 1:18)
You shall go forth to everyone to whom I will send you. And you shall speak all that I will command you.” (Jer 1:7)
Today I appoint you over nations and over kingdoms, to uproot and pull down, to destroy and overthrow, to build and to plant. (Jer 1:10)
They went forth, and preached the good news everywhere, the Lord worked with them and confirmed the word with signs that accompanied it. (Mrk 16:20)
We preach Christ to everyone. With all possible wisdom we warn and teach them in order to bring each one into God's presence as a mature individual in union with Christ. (Col 1:28)
Those who are wise shall shine like the brightness of the sky, and those who turn many to righteousness, like the stars for ever and ever. (Dan 12:3)

I will go before you, leveling mountains. I will break in pieces gates of bronze and smash their iron bars. I will give you treasures of darkness and riches in secret places; so that you will know that I am the Lord, the God of Israel who has called you by name. (Is 45:2-3)

Places that have been desolate for ages will be built up by you. You will raise a foundation for generation after generation. And you will be called the repairer of hedges, the restorer of Paths to dwell in. (Is 58:12)
Stand firm and be steadfast, always excelling in your work of the Lord, because you know that nothing you do in the Lord's service is ever in vain. (1 Cor 15:58)
He has appointed my mouth as a sharp sword. In the shadow of his hand, he has protected me. And he has appointed me as a chosen arrow. In his quiver, he has hidden me (Is 49:2)

The Lord said to me, “It is too small a thing that you should be my servant to restore to greatness the people of Israel who have survived, but I will also make you a light to the nations—so that my salvation will spread to the ends of the earth.” (Is 49:6)
I have proclaimed the glad tidings of deliverance in the great congregation; see, I have not restrained my lips, O Lord, as you know. (Ps 40:9)

What does the Lord your God require of you, but to fear the Lord your God, to walk in all his ways, to love him, to serve the Lord your God with all your heart and with all your soul, and to keep the commandments of the Lord and his statutes that I command you today, for your own good. (Deut 10:12-13)
I count my life of no value to myself, if only I may finish my course with joy and the ministry that I received from the Lord Jesus, to testify to the gospel of the grace of God. (Acts 20:24)
